passages.provision_quote: It is the policy of the state to do both of the following: (1) Achieve net zero greenhouse gas emissions as soon as possible, but no later than 2045, and to achieve and maintain net negative greenhouse gas emissions thereafter.
passages.note: Operative provision mandates net-zero emissions by a firm 2045 deadline, matching rung 1's clause.
Lee voted Aye on concurrence in Senate amendments, final passage of this single-subject climate bill, during his earlier term in this legislature.

rows.reasoning: Lee voted Aye on AB 1279 (2021-2022), a single-subject climate bill whose operative section declares it 'the policy of the state' to 'Achieve net zero greenhouse gas emissions as soon as possible, but no later than 2045' -- a mandate with a firm deadline, matching rung 1's text 'Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines' and excluding the subsidy, permitting, market-neutral and deregulatory rungs.
